instruments.title: Add Russia sectoral sanctions Regulation, Council Regulation (EU) No 833/2014
instruments.sourceLabel: EUR-Lex, Council Regulation (EU) No 833/2014 as published in the Official Journal

titles.en: Council Regulation (EU) No 833/2014 of 31 July 2014 concerning restrictive measures in view of Russia's actions destabilising the situation in Ukraine

obligations.title: Add the duty: Do not deal in securities of listed Russian issuers or sell EU-currency securities to Russian persons
obligations.sourceLabel: EUR-Lex, Council Regulation (EU) No 833/2014, consolidated text of 24 July 2026 (CELEX 02014R0833-20260724), Articles 5(1) to 5(4), 5a(1) and 5f

titles.en: Do not deal in securities of listed Russian issuers or sell EU-currency securities to Russian persons

summaries.en: Do not buy, sell, provide investment services for, assist in issuing or otherwise deal in transferable securities and money-market instruments issued after the cut-off dates by Russia, its government or the Central Bank of Russia, or by the Russian banks and companies listed in Annexes III, V, VI, XII and XIII, their non-EU entities owned more than 50 % and anyone acting for them. Do not sell to Russian nationals, residents of Russia or entities established there securities denominated in an official Member State currency issued after 12 April 2022 (in any other currency, after 6 August 2023) or fund units giving exposure to them; nationals of the EU, EEA or Switzerland and holders of a residence permit there are exempt from that sales ban.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Do not make new loans or credit to listed Russian entities or the Russian state
obligations.sourceLabel: EUR-Lex, Council Regulation (EU) No 833/2014, consolidated text of 24 July 2026 (CELEX 02014R0833-20260724), Articles 5(6), 5(7), 5a(2) and 5a(3)

titles.en: Do not make new loans or credit to listed Russian entities or the Russian state

summaries.en: Do not make, or take part in any arrangement to make, new loans or credit to the entities covered by the securities restrictions, to Russia or its government, to the Central Bank of Russia or to anyone acting for them. Loans with a specific, documented purpose of financing non-prohibited trade in goods and non-financial services between the Union and third states, and drawdowns under contracts concluded before the cut-off date on unchanged terms, remain possible only if the national competent authority is notified within three months.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Do not transact with the Central Bank of Russia or the entities listed for a full transaction ban
obligations.sourceLabel: EUR-Lex, Council Regulation (EU) No 833/2014, consolidated text of 24 July 2026 (CELEX 02014R0833-20260724), Articles 5a(4), 5aa(1), 5ac(2), 5ad(1) and (2), 5h(1) and (2)

titles.en: Do not transact with the Central Bank of Russia or the entities listed for a full transaction ban

summaries.en: Do not carry out transactions related to the management of the reserves and assets of the Central Bank of Russia or with anyone acting for it, and do not engage in any transaction with the state-linked entities in Annex XIX, the Russian banks in Annex XIV (from the date the Annex sets for each, including their Russian entities owned more than 50 %), the entities outside Russia in Annex XLIV, or the third-country banks, crypto-asset and payment service providers and other enablers in Annex XLV, or anyone acting for them. Only the exemptions and authorisations those articles set out allow such a transaction.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Report holdings of Central Bank of Russia assets and reserves every three months
obligations.sourceLabel: EUR-Lex, Council Regulation (EU) No 833/2014, consolidated text of 24 July 2026 (CELEX 02014R0833-20260724), Article 5a(4a)

titles.en: Report holdings of Central Bank of Russia assets and reserves every three months

summaries.en: Anyone holding or controlling, or acting as counterparty to, assets and reserves of the Central Bank of Russia, including financial sector entities, insurers, central securities depositories and central counterparties, reports them to the competent authority of its Member State and at the same time to the Commission, and updates the report every three months. The report identifies who owns, holds or controls the assets, gives their amount or market value at the reporting date and at immobilisation, and breaks them down by type.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Do not connect to SPFS or other Russian financial messaging systems
obligations.sourceLabel: EUR-Lex, Council Regulation (EU) No 833/2014, consolidated text of 24 July 2026 (CELEX 02014R0833-20260724), Article 5ac(1)

titles.en: Do not connect to SPFS or other Russian financial messaging systems

summaries.en: Entities established in the Union and operating outside Russia must not connect to the Central Bank of Russia's System for Transfer of Financial Messages (SPFS) or equivalent specialised financial messaging services it set up and, from 25 January 2026, to any system of the Central Bank of Russia or any Russian-provided system with a financial messaging function, such as the Fast Payment System (SBP) and Mir.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Refuse deposits above EUR 100 000 from Russian nationals, residents and entities
obligations.sourceLabel: EUR-Lex, Council Regulation (EU) No 833/2014, consolidated text of 24 July 2026 (CELEX 02014R0833-20260724), Article 5b(1) and (3)

titles.en: Refuse deposits above EUR 100 000 from Russian nationals, residents and entities

summaries.en: Do not accept deposits from Russian nationals, natural persons residing in Russia, entities established in Russia, or non-EU entities more than 50 % owned by Russian nationals or residents, once that person's total deposits with the credit institution exceed EUR 100 000. Nationals of a Member State, an EEA country or Switzerland and holders of a residence permit there are exempt.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Report deposits above EUR 100 000 held by Russian persons and update the list every 12 months
obligations.sourceLabel: EUR-Lex, Council Regulation (EU) No 833/2014, consolidated text of 24 July 2026 (CELEX 02014R0833-20260724), Article 5g(1)

titles.en: Report deposits above EUR 100 000 held by Russian persons and update the list every 12 months

summaries.en: Credit institutions supply the national competent authority of their Member State, or the Commission, with a list of deposits exceeding EUR 100 000 held by Russian nationals, natural persons residing in Russia, entities established in Russia and non-EU entities more than 50 % owned by Russian nationals or residents, and update the amounts every 12 months. They also report deposits above EUR 100 000 of Russian nationals or residents who obtained Member State citizenship or residence rights through an investor citizenship or residence scheme.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Do not provide crypto-asset services to Russian persons or deal with Russian crypto platforms
obligations.sourceLabel: EUR-Lex, Council Regulation (EU) No 833/2014, consolidated text of 24 July 2026 (CELEX 02014R0833-20260724), Articles 5b(2)(a), 5b(3), 5ba, 5bb and 5bc

titles.en: Do not provide crypto-asset services to Russian persons or deal with Russian crypto platforms

summaries.en: Do not provide crypto-asset services within the meaning of Regulation (EU) 2023/1114 to Russian nationals, natural persons residing in Russia or entities established in Russia; EU, EEA and Swiss nationals and residence-permit holders are exempt. Do not engage in transactions involving the crypto-assets or central bank digital currencies listed in Annex LIII, with crypto-asset service providers or exchange platforms established in Russia (from 24 May 2026), or with those established in the third countries listed in Annex LVII.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Do not issue payment instruments or e-money, or acquire or initiate payments, for Russian persons
obligations.sourceLabel: EUR-Lex, Council Regulation (EU) No 833/2014, consolidated text of 24 July 2026 (CELEX 02014R0833-20260724), Articles 5b(2)(b) and (c), 5b(3) and 5c(1a)

titles.en: Do not issue payment instruments or e-money, or acquire or initiate payments, for Russian persons

summaries.en: Do not provide Russian nationals, natural persons residing in Russia or entities established in Russia with the issuing of payment instruments, the acquiring of payment transactions, payment initiation services or the issuing of electronic money. EU, EEA and Swiss nationals and residence-permit holders are exempt, and personalised security credentials needed to access an account with a credit or electronic money institution in a Member State or a listed partner country may still be provided.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Give the competent authority any information that helps implement the Russia sectoral sanctions within two weeks
obligations.sourceLabel: EUR-Lex, Council Regulation (EU) No 833/2014, consolidated text of 24 July 2026 (CELEX 02014R0833-20260724), Article 6b(1)

titles.en: Give the competent authority any information that helps implement the Russia sectoral sanctions within two weeks

summaries.en: Supply the competent authority of the Member State where the firm is resident or located with any information that would facilitate the implementation of the Regulation within two weeks of acquiring it, and cooperate with the authority in any verification of that information. The confidentiality of lawyer-client communications is respected.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Use best efforts so that owned or controlled entities outside the Union do not undermine the Russia sectoral sanctions
obligations.sourceLabel: EUR-Lex, Council Regulation (EU) No 833/2014, consolidated text of 24 July 2026 (CELEX 02014R0833-20260724), Article 8a

titles.en: Use best efforts so that owned or controlled entities outside the Union do not undermine the Russia sectoral sanctions

summaries.en: Undertake best efforts to ensure that any legal person, entity or body established outside the Union that the firm owns or controls does not take part in activities that undermine the restrictive measures of the Regulation.

instruments.title: Add Russia/Ukraine asset freeze Regulation, Council Regulation (EU) No 269/2014
instruments.sourceLabel: EUR-Lex, Council Regulation (EU) No 269/2014 as published in the Official Journal

titles.en: Council Regulation (EU) No 269/2014 of 17 March 2014 concerning restrictive measures in respect of actions undermining or threatening the territorial integrity, sovereignty and independence of Ukraine

obligations.title: Add the duty: Freeze the funds and economic resources of persons listed under the Russia/Ukraine asset freeze
obligations.sourceLabel: EUR-Lex, Council Regulation (EU) No 269/2014, consolidated text of 7 August 2026 (CELEX 02014R0269-20260807), Article 2(1)

titles.en: Freeze the funds and economic resources of persons listed under the Russia/Ukraine asset freeze

summaries.en: Freeze all funds and economic resources that belong to, or are owned, held or controlled by, the natural or legal persons, entities and bodies listed in Annex I.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Make no funds or economic resources available to persons listed under the Russia/Ukraine asset freeze
obligations.sourceLabel: EUR-Lex, Council Regulation (EU) No 269/2014, consolidated text of 7 August 2026 (CELEX 02014R0269-20260807), Articles 2(2) and 7(1)

titles.en: Make no funds or economic resources available to persons listed under the Russia/Ukraine asset freeze

summaries.en: Do not make funds or economic resources available, directly or indirectly, to or for the benefit of the persons, entities and bodies listed in Annex I. A financial or credit institution may credit a frozen account with funds transferred by third parties only if the additions are frozen too, and it informs the competent authority of each such transaction without delay.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Report frozen funds to the competent authority within two weeks, with the required details
obligations.sourceLabel: EUR-Lex, Council Regulation (EU) No 269/2014, consolidated text of 7 August 2026 (CELEX 02014R0269-20260807), Article 8(1)(a) and (1a)

titles.en: Report frozen funds to the competent authority within two weeks, with the required details

summaries.en: Report funds and economic resources frozen under the Regulation to the competent authority of the Member State where the firm is resident or located within two weeks of acquiring the information. The report identifies the owners or controllers (name, address and VAT or tax identification number), gives the amount or market value at the reporting date and at the date of freezing, and breaks the assets down by type, including crypto-assets, with quantity and location where available.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Report unfrozen assets of listed persons and pre-listing movements, and cooperate in verification
obligations.sourceLabel: EUR-Lex, Council Regulation (EU) No 269/2014, consolidated text of 7 August 2026 (CELEX 02014R0269-20260807), Article 8(1)(a) and (b)

titles.en: Report unfrozen assets of listed persons and pre-listing movements, and cooperate in verification

summaries.en: Within two weeks of acquiring it, give the competent authority any information held about funds or economic resources in the Union belonging to listed persons that have not been treated as frozen by those obliged to freeze them, and about such assets that were moved, transferred, used or otherwise dealt with in the two weeks before the person was listed. Cooperate with the authority in any verification of that information.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Use best efforts so that owned or controlled entities outside the Union do not undermine the Russia/Ukraine asset freeze
obligations.sourceLabel: EUR-Lex, Council Regulation (EU) No 269/2014, consolidated text of 7 August 2026 (CELEX 02014R0269-20260807), Article 15a

titles.en: Use best efforts so that owned or controlled entities outside the Union do not undermine the Russia/Ukraine asset freeze

summaries.en: Undertake best efforts to ensure that any legal person, entity or body established outside the Union that the firm owns or controls does not take part in activities that undermine the restrictive measures of the Regulation.

instruments.title: Add Belarus sanctions Regulation, Council Regulation (EC) No 765/2006
instruments.sourceLabel: EUR-Lex, Council Regulation (EC) No 765/2006 as published in the Official Journal; title as amended, read in the consolidated text of 24 July 2026 (CELEX 02006R0765-20260724)

titles.en: Council Regulation (EC) No 765/2006 of 18 May 2006 concerning restrictive measures in view of the situation in Belarus and the involvement of Belarus in the Russian aggression against Ukraine

obligations.title: Add the duty: Freeze the funds of persons listed under the Belarus sanctions and make none available to them
obligations.sourceLabel: EUR-Lex, Council Regulation (EC) No 765/2006, consolidated text of 24 July 2026 (CELEX 02006R0765-20260724), Article 2(1) and (2)

titles.en: Freeze the funds of persons listed under the Belarus sanctions and make none available to them

summaries.en: Freeze all funds and economic resources that belong to, or are owned, held or controlled by, the natural or legal persons, entities and bodies listed in Annex I, and do not make funds or economic resources available to them or for their benefit, directly or indirectly.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Report frozen funds and other useful information under the Belarus sanctions and cooperate with the authority
obligations.sourceLabel: EUR-Lex, Council Regulation (EC) No 765/2006, consolidated text of 24 July 2026 (CELEX 02006R0765-20260724), Articles 5(1) and 8j(1)

titles.en: Report frozen funds and other useful information under the Belarus sanctions and cooperate with the authority

summaries.en: Supply the competent authority of the country where the firm is resident or located immediately with any information that would facilitate compliance, such as accounts and amounts frozen, and pass it to the Commission; supply any other information that would facilitate implementation of the Regulation within two weeks of acquiring it. Cooperate with the authority in any verification of the information.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Do not finance, deal in securities of, or transact with the restricted Belarusian state bodies and banks
obligations.sourceLabel: EUR-Lex, Council Regulation (EC) No 765/2006, consolidated text of 24 July 2026 (CELEX 02006R0765-20260724), Articles 1j, 1ja(1), 1k(1) and (2) and 1zb(1)

titles.en: Do not finance, deal in securities of, or transact with the restricted Belarusian state bodies and banks

summaries.en: Do not deal in transferable securities or money-market instruments with a maturity over 90 days issued after 29 June 2021 by Belarus, its government, public bodies, corporations or agencies or the state-controlled banks in Annex IX (or their non-EU entities owned more than 50 % and anyone acting for them), and do not make new loans or credit with a maturity over 90 days to them, except loans with a documented purpose of financing non-prohibited trade. Do not carry out transactions related to the reserves and assets of the Central Bank of Belarus, or any transaction with the entities in Annex XV and their Belarusian entities owned more than 50 %.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Refuse deposits above EUR 100 000 from Belarusian nationals, residents and entities
obligations.sourceLabel: EUR-Lex, Council Regulation (EC) No 765/2006, consolidated text of 24 July 2026 (CELEX 02006R0765-20260724), Article 1u(1) and (4)

titles.en: Refuse deposits above EUR 100 000 from Belarusian nationals, residents and entities

summaries.en: Do not accept deposits from Belarusian nationals, natural persons residing in Belarus, entities established in Belarus, or non-EU entities more than 50 % owned by Belarusian nationals or residents, once that person's total deposits with the credit institution exceed EUR 100 000. Nationals of a Member State, an EEA country or Switzerland and holders of a residence permit there are exempt.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Do not provide crypto-asset, payment-instrument, acquiring, payment-initiation or e-money services to Belarusian persons
obligations.sourceLabel: EUR-Lex, Council Regulation (EC) No 765/2006, consolidated text of 24 July 2026 (CELEX 02006R0765-20260724), Article 1u(2) and (4)

titles.en: Do not provide crypto-asset, payment-instrument, acquiring, payment-initiation or e-money services to Belarusian persons

summaries.en: Do not provide Belarusian nationals, natural persons residing in Belarus or entities established in Belarus with crypto-asset services, the issuing of payment instruments, the acquiring of payment transactions, payment initiation services or the issuing of electronic money. The ban began with crypto-asset wallet, account and custody services and has covered the full list since 24 October 2025; EU, EEA and Swiss nationals and residence-permit holders are exempt.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Report deposits above EUR 100 000 held by Belarusian persons and update the list every 12 months
obligations.sourceLabel: EUR-Lex, Council Regulation (EC) No 765/2006, consolidated text of 24 July 2026 (CELEX 02006R0765-20260724), Article 1z

titles.en: Report deposits above EUR 100 000 held by Belarusian persons and update the list every 12 months

summaries.en: Credit institutions supply the national competent authority of their Member State, or the Commission, with a list of deposits exceeding EUR 100 000 held by Belarusian nationals, natural persons residing in Belarus or entities established in Belarus, and update the amounts every 12 months. They also report such deposits of Belarusian nationals or residents who obtained Member State citizenship or residence rights through an investor scheme.

instruments.title: Add Iran non-proliferation sanctions Regulation, Council Regulation (EU) No 267/2012
instruments.sourceLabel: EUR-Lex, Council Regulation (EU) No 267/2012 as published in the Official Journal

titles.en: Council Regulation (EU) No 267/2012 of 23 March 2012 concerning restrictive measures against Iran and repealing Regulation (EU) No 961/2010

obligations.title: Add the duty: Freeze the funds of persons listed under the Iran non-proliferation sanctions and make none available to them
obligations.sourceLabel: EUR-Lex, Council Regulation (EU) No 267/2012, consolidated text of 1 August 2026 (CELEX 02012R0267-20260801), Article 23(1) to (4)

titles.en: Freeze the funds of persons listed under the Iran non-proliferation sanctions and make none available to them

summaries.en: Freeze all funds and economic resources that belong to, or are owned, held or controlled by, the persons, entities and bodies listed in Annexes VIII and IX, do not make funds or economic resources available to them or for their benefit, directly or indirectly, and do not supply them with specialised financial messaging services.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Report frozen funds under the Iran non-proliferation sanctions and cooperate with the competent authority
obligations.sourceLabel: EUR-Lex, Council Regulation (EU) No 267/2012, consolidated text of 1 August 2026 (CELEX 02012R0267-20260801), Article 40(1)

titles.en: Report frozen funds under the Iran non-proliferation sanctions and cooperate with the competent authority

summaries.en: Supply the competent authority of the Member State where the firm is resident or located immediately with any information that would facilitate compliance with the Regulation, such as accounts and amounts frozen, and transmit it to the Commission directly or through the Member State. Cooperate with the authority in any verification of that information.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Do not transfer funds to or from Iranian banks unless the transfer is permitted and authorised
obligations.sourceLabel: EUR-Lex, Council Regulation (EU) No 267/2012, consolidated text of 1 August 2026 (CELEX 02012R0267-20260801), Article 30(1) to (3)

titles.en: Do not transfer funds to or from Iranian banks unless the transfer is permitted and authorised

summaries.en: Do not transfer funds between the firm and credit or financial institutions or bureaux de change domiciled in Iran, their branches and subsidiaries, or institutions controlled from Iran, unless the transfer falls in a permitted category (such as foodstuffs, healthcare, humanitarian purposes, personal remittances or a specific non-prohibited trade contract) and is processed as the Regulation sets out: notified in advance from EUR 10 000 and, above the set thresholds, authorised in advance by the competent authority.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Notify, or seek authorisation for, transfers of funds to and from Iranian persons
obligations.sourceLabel: EUR-Lex, Council Regulation (EU) No 267/2012, consolidated text of 1 August 2026 (CELEX 02012R0267-20260801), Article 30a(1) to (3)

titles.en: Notify, or seek authorisation for, transfers of funds to and from Iranian persons

summaries.en: For transfers to or from an Iranian person, entity or body that are not covered by the Iranian-bank rule, notify the competent authority in advance in writing of transfers of EUR 10 000 or more for foodstuffs, healthcare, medical, agricultural or humanitarian purposes and of other transfers below EUR 40 000, and obtain its prior authorisation for any other transfer of EUR 40 000 or more. The payer's or payee's payment service provider files the notification or request with the authority of the Member State where it is established.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Do not open accounts, correspondent relationships or offices with Iranian banks or trade new Iranian public bonds
obligations.sourceLabel: EUR-Lex, Council Regulation (EU) No 267/2012, consolidated text of 1 August 2026 (CELEX 02012R0267-20260801), Articles 33(1) and 34(a)

titles.en: Do not open accounts, correspondent relationships or offices with Iranian banks or trade new Iranian public bonds

summaries.en: Credit and financial institutions must not open a new account with, or establish a new correspondent banking relationship or joint venture with, a credit or financial institution domiciled in Iran or controlled from Iran, and must not open a new representative office, branch or subsidiary in Iran. Do not sell or buy public or public-guaranteed bonds issued after 30 September 2025 to or from Iran, its public bodies, Iranian banks or those acting for or owned by them.

instruments.sourceLabel: EUR-Lex, Council Regulation (EU) 2017/1509 as published in the Official Journal

obligations.title: Add the duty: Freeze the funds of persons listed under the DPRK sanctions and make none available to them
obligations.sourceLabel: EUR-Lex, Council Regulation (EU) 2017/1509, consolidated text of 17 December 2025 (CELEX 02017R1509-20251217), Article 34(1) and (3)

titles.en: Freeze the funds of persons listed under the DPRK sanctions and make none available to them

summaries.en: Freeze all funds and economic resources that belong to, or are owned, held or controlled by, the persons, entities and bodies listed in Annexes XIII, XV, XVI and XVII, and do not make funds or economic resources available to them or for their benefit, directly or indirectly.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Report frozen funds under the DPRK sanctions and cooperate with the competent authority
obligations.sourceLabel: EUR-Lex, Council Regulation (EU) 2017/1509, consolidated text of 17 December 2025 (CELEX 02017R1509-20251217), Article 50(1)

titles.en: Report frozen funds under the DPRK sanctions and cooperate with the competent authority

summaries.en: Supply the competent authority of the Member State where the firm is resident or located immediately with any information that would facilitate compliance with the Regulation, such as accounts and amounts frozen, and transmit it promptly to the Commission directly or through the Member State. Cooperate with the authority in any verification of that information.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Do not transfer funds to or from the DPRK, deal with DPRK banks or finance trade with the DPRK
obligations.sourceLabel: EUR-Lex, Council Regulation (EU) 2017/1509, consolidated text of 17 December 2025 (CELEX 02017R1509-20251217), Articles 21(1) to (5) and 32

titles.en: Do not transfer funds to or from the DPRK, deal with DPRK banks or finance trade with the DPRK

summaries.en: Do not transfer or clear funds to or from the DPRK, and do not enter into or continue transactions with credit and financial institutions domiciled in the DPRK, their branches and subsidiaries, or institutions controlled from the DPRK. Small transfers for food, health, humanitarian, trade, development or diplomatic purposes up to EUR 15 000 and personal remittances up to EUR 5 000 are exempt. Do not provide financing or financial assistance for trade with the DPRK, including export credits, guarantees or insurance.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Hold no accounts or correspondent relationships with DPRK banks and report suspected proliferation financing
obligations.sourceLabel: EUR-Lex, Council Regulation (EU) 2017/1509, consolidated text of 17 December 2025 (CELEX 02017R1509-20251217), Articles 23(1) and 24

titles.en: Hold no accounts or correspondent relationships with DPRK banks and report suspected proliferation financing

summaries.en: Do not open accounts with, establish correspondent banking relationships or joint ventures with, or take ownership interests in, DPRK credit and financial institutions, or open offices, branches or subsidiaries in the DPRK. In any dealings with those institutions, apply customer due diligence, refuse transfers with missing payer or payee information, keep transaction records, promptly notify the financial intelligence unit of suspected proliferation financing and hold such transactions until it has been informed and its instructions followed.

obligations.sourceLabel: EUR-Lex, Council Regulation (EU) 2022/263, consolidated text of 25 February 2025 (CELEX 02022R0263-20250225), Article 3(1) and (3)

titles.en: Do not finance, invest in or provide investment services for entities and real estate in the specified areas of Ukraine

summaries.en: Do not acquire or extend participations in real estate or entities in the non-government controlled areas of Ukraine the Regulation specifies, grant or take part in arrangements to grant loans, credit or other financing (including equity capital) to an entity there, create joint ventures there, or provide investment services directly related to those activities. Obligations under contracts concluded before 23 February 2022 may be executed only after informing the competent authority at least five working days in advance.

instruments.title: Add Blocking Statute, Council Regulation (EC) No 2271/96
instruments.sourceLabel: EUR-Lex, Council Regulation (EC) No 2271/96 as published in the Official Journal

titles.en: Council Regulation (EC) No 2271/96 of 22 November 1996 protecting against the effects of the extra-territorial application of legislation adopted by a third country, and actions based thereon or resulting therefrom

obligations.title: Add the duty: Inform the Commission within 30 days when listed extra-territorial laws affect the firm's interests
obligations.sourceLabel: EUR-Lex, Council Regulation (EC) No 2271/96, consolidated text of 7 August 2018 (CELEX 01996R2271-20180807), Article 2

titles.en: Inform the Commission within 30 days when listed extra-territorial laws affect the firm's interests

summaries.en: Where the firm's economic or financial interests are affected, directly or indirectly, by the third-country laws listed in the Annex or by actions based on them, inform the Commission within 30 days of obtaining that information; for a legal person the duty rests with its directors, managers and others with management responsibilities. Provide any further information the Commission requests within 30 days of the request, directly or through the Member State's competent authorities.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Do not comply with the third-country sanctions laws listed in the Blocking Statute
obligations.sourceLabel: EUR-Lex, Council Regulation (EC) No 2271/96, consolidated text of 7 August 2018 (CELEX 01996R2271-20180807), Article 5

titles.en: Do not comply with the third-country sanctions laws listed in the Blocking Statute

summaries.en: Do not comply, directly or through a subsidiary or other intermediary, actively or by deliberate omission, with any requirement or prohibition, including requests of foreign courts, based on the laws listed in the Annex or on actions based on them, unless the Commission has authorised full or partial compliance because non-compliance would seriously damage the firm's or the Union's interests.

instruments.title: Add Restrictive Measures Guidelines, EBA/GL/2024/14
instruments.sourceLabel: European Banking Authority, EBA/GL/2024/14 (Restrictive Measures Guidelines) guideline page

titles.en: Guidelines on internal policies, procedures and controls to ensure the implementation of Union and national restrictive measures

obligations.title: Add the duty: Give the management body ownership of the restrictive measures compliance strategy
obligations.sourceLabel: European Banking Authority, final report on EBA/GL/2024/14 and EBA/GL/2024/15, Paragraphs 3 to 12

titles.en: Give the management body ownership of the restrictive measures compliance strategy

summaries.en: The management body approves the strategy for complying with restrictive measures and oversees its implementation; in its supervisory function it is informed of the exposure assessment, monitors the adequacy of policies and procedures and, at least once a year, assesses whether the compliance function and its human and technical resources work effectively. A parent undertaking makes sure each group entity has what it needs to comply.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Appoint a senior staff member in charge of restrictive measures compliance
obligations.sourceLabel: European Banking Authority, final report on EBA/GL/2024/14 and EBA/GL/2024/15, Paragraphs 13 to 21

titles.en: Appoint a senior staff member in charge of restrictive measures compliance

summaries.en: Appoint a senior staff member with the necessary knowledge who develops and maintains the policies, procedures and controls, has direct access to the management body and gives it regular information (exposure changes, alert and report statistics, frozen assets, deficiencies, breaches), reports all violations to the competent national authorities and cooperates with them. The role may be combined with another function, such as the AML/CFT compliance officer, only where size and exposure justify it and no conflict of interest arises.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Assess and document the firm's exposure to restrictive measures and review it at least yearly
obligations.sourceLabel: European Banking Authority, final report on EBA/GL/2024/14 and EBA/GL/2024/15, Paragraphs 22 to 28

titles.en: Assess and document the firm's exposure to restrictive measures and review it at least yearly

summaries.en: Identify which restrictive measures regimes apply and assess the likelihood of non-implementation and circumvention and the impact of breaches, considering geographic, customer, product and service, and delivery-channel risk, from a diverse range of information sources. Review the assessment at least once a year and when new measures, products, markets or deficiencies call for it, and document the methodology and outcome for the competent authority.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Keep restrictive measures policies and controls able to apply every measure without delay
obligations.sourceLabel: European Banking Authority, final report on EBA/GL/2024/14 and EBA/GL/2024/15, Paragraphs 29 to 30

titles.en: Keep restrictive measures policies and controls able to apply every measure without delay

summaries.en: Policies, procedures and controls must let the firm implement all applicable restrictive measures without delay: keep the information and lists current as soon as measures enter into force, start investigating every potential match without delay, and on a true match reject, suspend or freeze and report to the competent authority within the applicable deadlines. Review and update the policies regularly and set out responsibilities in a documented internal organisation, including for outsourcing.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Train staff regularly on restrictive measures and the firm's controls
obligations.sourceLabel: European Banking Authority, final report on EBA/GL/2024/14 and EBA/GL/2024/15, Paragraphs 31 to 33

titles.en: Train staff regularly on restrictive measures and the firm's controls

summaries.en: Provide regular training, tailored to each role, so staff know the applicable restrictive measures, the outcome of the exposure assessment and the policies, procedures and controls; document the training plan and be ready to show the competent authority that the training is adequate and effective.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Choose, review and keep up to date a screening system that reliably identifies sanctions targets
obligations.sourceLabel: European Banking Authority, final report on EBA/GL/2024/14 and EBA/GL/2024/15, Paragraphs 3 to 9, 24 to 30

titles.en: Choose, review and keep up to date a screening system that reliably identifies sanctions targets

summaries.en: Payment and crypto-asset service providers choose a screening system suited to their size and exposure, document its capabilities and limitations, review it at least once a year and calibrate its matching, including fuzzy matching, so that it neither misses targets nor floods analysts with false alerts. They detect new, amended or lifted measures and update the screened lists immediately after the change enters into force, and remain responsible for compliance when screening is outsourced.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Screen the whole customer base regularly and at every trigger event, including beneficial owners
obligations.sourceLabel: European Banking Authority, final report on EBA/GL/2024/14 and EBA/GL/2024/15, Paragraphs 14 to 18

titles.en: Screen the whole customer base regularly and at every trigger event, including beneficial owners

summaries.en: Screen the entire customer database at a frequency set by the exposure assessment and always at onboarding, when designations or measures change, when customer due diligence data change materially and when circumvention is suspected. Screen at least names (original and transliterated), dates of birth, aliases and listed wallet addresses, and also beneficial owners and anyone acting for the customer.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Screen every transfer of funds or crypto-assets and all its parties before making the funds available
obligations.sourceLabel: European Banking Authority, final report on EBA/GL/2024/14 and EBA/GL/2024/15, Paragraphs 19 to 23

titles.en: Screen every transfer of funds or crypto-assets and all its parties before making the funds available

summaries.en: Screen transfers of funds before making them available to the payee, and transfers of crypto-assets before making them available to the beneficiary, against all applicable measures. Screen all parties and all relevant data, including payer, payee, originator and beneficiary information, the purpose and free-text fields, the institutions involved and their identifier codes, and wallet addresses on official lists, as well as information obtained later.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Investigate sanctions alerts without delay and assess ownership and control by designated persons
obligations.sourceLabel: European Banking Authority, final report on EBA/GL/2024/14 and EBA/GL/2024/15, Paragraphs 31 to 46

titles.en: Investigate sanctions alerts without delay and assess ownership and control by designated persons

summaries.en: Have documented procedures to investigate every potential match without delay, with at least two-person review for higher-exposure situations, using additional customer data when a match is unclear and refraining from serving the party until an informed decision is reached. Assess whether an entity is owned or controlled by a designated person using the EU Council criteria and beneficial ownership sources, and keep due diligence able to detect circumvention, such as altered payment messages or structured transfers.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Suspend, freeze and report confirmed sanctions matches without delay
obligations.sourceLabel: European Banking Authority, final report on EBA/GL/2024/14 and EBA/GL/2024/15, Paragraphs 47 to 54

titles.en: Suspend, freeze and report confirmed sanctions matches without delay

summaries.en: Suspend without delay any operation that triggers an alert of a possible match and, once the match is confirmed, immediately freeze the funds (for crypto-assets, block them in a suspense account) and stop transfers that would breach the measures. Report the action taken, any violation discovered and any executed transfer in breach to the competent national authority without delay or within the set deadline, report suspected circumvention where a sanctions regulation or anti-money laundering law requires it, and have procedures for derogations and for lifted measures.
